newsitem.title: USA: Ecopetrol awards Cusiana, Cao Limon crude cargoes.
newsitem.headline: Ecopetrol awards Cusiana, Cao Limon crude cargoes.

text.p: Colombia's state oil company Ecopetrol awarded two cargoes of Cusiana crude oil and one cargo of Cao Limon crude, trade sources said on Monday.
The Cusiana cargos were sold to a U.S. East Coast refiner at around $1.35 a barrel under September West Texas Intermediate/Cushing, the sources said.
The cargoes, totalling one million to 1.1 million barrels, will be co-loaded at the Colombian port of Coveas in the third decade of July.
Ecopetrol sold the Cao Limon cargo to Petrotrin, the state oil concern of Trinidad and Tobago, at an undisclosed discount to WTI/Cushing, trade sources said.
